examples: I go to the school (el edificio)

grammar.rule: Hábitos en el pasado que ya no ocurren.

practice_writing.instructions: Escribe un párrafo sobre tu camino hacia la felicidad utilizando 'used to' y artículos correctamente.
practice_writing.example_text: In the past, I used to think that money was the only way to find happiness...

study: Lee la regla de artículos y subraya 5 ejemplos.
Escribe 3 oraciones con 'used to' y corrige tiempos.
practice: Contrasta 'go to school' vs 'go to the school' en dos oraciones.
tips: 'Used to' no se usa para hábitos actuales.
sentence_prompts: Write a sentence with 'used to' about a past habit.
Use 'the' only when referring to a specific object.

grammar.rule: Cuando el sujeto y el objeto son el mismo.
examples: I told myself to be open-minded.
I went to the gallery to see art.
If the exhibition is interesting, I will write a review.

practice_writing.instructions: Escribe un párrafo sobre una exposición que planeas visitar usando un primer condicional.
practice_writing.example_text: I bought a ticket to see the new abstract art exhibition...

practice: Escribe 3 oraciones con 'to' + verbo indicando propósito.
tips: El primer condicional usa presente en la cláusula 'if'.
sentence_prompts: Write an 'if' sentence about visiting a gallery.

examples: If I won the lottery, I would give half to charity.
People who help others inspire me.

practice_writing.instructions: Describe cómo usarías dinero para ayudar a tu comunidad usando el segundo condicional.

tips: Usa 'were' para 'If I were...' en registro formal.
sentence_prompts: Write a sentence starting 'If I had money, I would...'

examples: My smartphone is faster than my tablet.
It is the most useful device I own.
We need to update our skills.

practice_writing.instructions: Compara dos dispositivos e incluye un superlativo y 'need to'.
practice_writing.example_text: My new smartphone is faster than my old tablet...

sentence_prompts: Write a superlative sentence about a device.

examples: Plastic is found in the ocean.

practice_writing.instructions: Describe un problema ambiental usando voz pasiva y 'It is [adj] to [verb]'.

study: Identifica 3 oraciones pasivas en un artículo.
tips: No uses 'by' si el agente no es importante.
sentence_prompts: Write a passive sentence about animals.

examples: He said that fake news had become a big problem.
We should check sources before sharing.

practice_writing.instructions: Redacta un breve comentario sobre medios usando reported speech y past perfect.
practice_writing.example_text: The journalist said that fake news had become a big problem...

study: Convierte 3 frases directas a estilo indirecto.
sentence_prompts: Write a sentence using 'He said that ...'.
